name: Dorothy Jean Forester (Cox)
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Cox Family Tree" (tree 17224056)
notes: Daughter of Glenn C. and Ruth (Borton) Forester. Born 22 Oct 1931 at Clear Lake, Indiana; married Loren Wayne Cox on 4 Jul 1951 at Clear Lake; died 1 Jan 1987 at Jackson, Michigan; buried at Ransom, Hillsdale County, Michigan.
